label: Chapter House, York Minster
note: 13th-century octagonal chapter house without a central pillar, max height 20.3 m, length 19.2 m glass to glass, floor about 240 m2 (paper, Table 1); measured 26 May 2019, unoccupied, T30 about 5.4 s at 500 Hz-1 kHz; Soundfield ST450 read as FuMa (Info.txt: 'B-format, Normalised'), but the direct sound's X+Y+Z to W energy is 3.0 to 3.75 where FuMa gives 2, so the W gain is not certain (as in house_of_commons_1820); the measured files hold content only up to about 8.7 kHz (band-limited in all 18), so their 8 kHz octave values describe 5.6-8.7 kHz only (T30 1.81 s, against 2.71 s in the model)

label: Chapter House, York Minster (ODEON model)
note: ODEON 14 model of the chapter house (paper, Section 3.2); conditions model01 (the room today, 43 IRs) and model02 (before the restoration, 43 IRs, simulated T30 about 4.3 s, paper Table 5); sources S1-S3 and receivers R01-R17 (S3 and R12-R17 exist only in the model); the B-format is FuMa (direct-sound X+Y+Z to W energy about 2); ODEON aims each receiver at the source (Y is zero in the direct sound)
